purpose: Manufacturer-guidance layer for Garden Labs. This file records Home Grown guidance and reconciliation candidates without overwriting Grow Guide facts, packet evidence, or canonical Garden X data.

policy.notes: Home Grown guidance is preserved with provenance. Soil/container/outdoor instructions are not silently converted into hydroponic rules. Conflicts remain explicit until reviewed.
